links.outcome: Alert burden per patient-day after deployment of rule-based alerts
links.effect: Alert burden averaged 0.23 alerts/patient-day with around 4% duplicate suppression; sensitivity 0.88 and PPV 0.83 against an operational composite.
links.quote: Alert burden averaged 0.23 alerts/patient-day with around 4% duplicate suppression.

unlisted_practices: Rule-based real-time alerts with trend, freshness and de-duplication logic to shorten result-to-treatment time
Role-based routing of alerts to team chats
Continuous system telemetry (poll cadence, dispatch latency) for monitoring

screen.reason: The system evaluated is a declarative, rule-based clinical decision support tool (thresholds, trends, freshness rules) rather than an artificial intelligence, machine learning, or foundation model system.
